name: Process Step Action
description: What the engine does automatically when a step (or the whole process) reaches an outcome. Rows are dispatched server-side on save of the result, so the automation cannot be bypassed by the client.

fields.label: Trigger
fields.options:
On Answer
On Pass
On Fail
On Critical
On Skip
On Out Of Range
On Option
On Stage Complete
On Process Complete

fields.label: Trigger Value
fields.description: Only for the On Option trigger — the option value that fires this action.

fields.label: Action
fields.options:
Notify Role
Notify User
Raise Deviation
Block Stage
Quarantine Run
Set Run Status
Require Photo
Require Remark
Jump To Step
Set Field On Subject
Create Document
Send Email
Send SMS
Add Tag
Run Server Script

fields.label: Target
fields.description: Role name, user, stage_code, step_code, fieldname, doctype or Server Script name — whichever the action needs.

fields.label: Message
fields.description: Jinja over the run context: {{ run.name }}, {{ step.label }}, {{ result.response }}, {{ subject }}.

fields.label: Extra Parameters (JSON)
fields.description: Optional JSON object for actions that need more than a target, e.g. {"value": "Hold"}.
